Protocol pins actual wrapper SHA; execution spec pins protocol/configuration/two calls/zero builds.
Full expected adapter argument list is reconstructed and compared, including own member/build, engine/audit/protocol hashes, work/output and explicit diagnostic flag.
Exclusive new profile directory and unchanged adapter own attempt marker prevent automatic retry/overwrite.
nsys profile runs foreground under immutable monitor with stdin disabled and bounded 240-second wait.
Profile target is setsid --wait Python adapter; reviewed adapter independently rejects non-private PID/PGID/SID and requires live independent child-guard ACK before GPU import.
Profile error/returncode/argv/elapsed are saved in finally, with no re-launch loop.
Escaped runner group snapshot and guard process nonlive state are required before export; guard status string alone never establishes empty group.

Missing runner identity returns explicit no-ack observation; successful-export branch separately requires runner_group_fully_empty true and complete two-call receipt.
Zero nsys/adapter returncode, two completed calls and all attempted calls synchronized are required before export.
Exactly one profile report is exported to SQLite with separate bounded 35-second subprocess; failed export cannot re-run inference.
Wrapper has no model build, direct GPU imports, engine calls or guessed-PID signals; authenticated child/outer guards handle cleanup.
